# wizard

```go
import "github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/component/wizard"
```

Package wizard is a form split into pages the app defines: the steps drawn along the top, one page's form under them, and Back and Next underneath. A page can check its form before the wizard leaves it.


<a name="Styles"></a>
## type [Styles](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/wizard/wizard.go#L68-L75>)

Styles are how the steps, the error and the buttons are painted; each page's form keeps its own.

```go
type Styles struct {
    Done    lipgloss.Style // a step behind the current one
    Current lipgloss.Style
    Ahead   lipgloss.Style // a step not reached yet
    Line    lipgloss.Style // the rule between steps
    Error   lipgloss.Style // a check that failed
    Button  draw.ButtonStyle
}
```

<a name="DefaultStyles"></a>
### func [DefaultStyles](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/wizard/wizard.go#L79>)

```go
func DefaultStyles(th theme.Resolved) Styles
```

DefaultStyles mark the steps behind in success and the current one in the accent, mute the rest and paint a failed check in danger.
